toegepas.na: die San en die Khoikhoi ontmoet
toegepas.rede_vinder: Repeating the article makes clear these are two separate peoples, not one group.
toegepas.fout: One article over two separate peoples reads as if San and Khoikhoi were one group.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating 'die' is the natural Afrikaans for two distinct peoples and changes no meaning; no protected word is touched.

toegepas.voor: en saam vertel hulle ons die meeste
toegepas.na: en saam vertel die bronne ons die meeste
toegepas.rede_vinder: Plural 'hulle' refers back to singular 'Elke bron'; naming the sources fixes the reference.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' after a paragraph about people and researchers can point to them rather than to the sources, and 'hulle ons' is clumsy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'die bronne' (the protected video word, unchanged) fixes the reference without altering the claim or the qualifier 'die meeste'.

na_skrywer.voor: wat ons iets van vandag en van lank gelede vertel
na_skrywer.na: wat vir ons iets oor vandag en oor lank gelede vertel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'wat ons iets ... vertel' can be misread as 'which we tell'; 'vir ons' and 'oor' make the subject and topic clear.
na_skrywer.fout: 'wat ons iets ... vertel' can be read with 'ons' as the subject (things we tell).
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons, so only the writer may reword it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Navorsers leer ook deur mense wat vandag leef dop te hou
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Navorsers leer ook meer deur mense wat vandag leef, dop te hou
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'leer ook' needs an object to read naturally, and a comma after the embedded relative clause helps a Grade 5 reader find the verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'leer' needs no object, 'meer' adds a comparison the original does not make, and the comma splits the 'deur ... dop te hou' construction.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: geskilder of in die klip ingekerf
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence switches from 'op rotse' to 'in die klip' for the same surface; 'daarin' refers back to the rocks without the jump.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original reads naturally and 'in die klip' echoes the decided rotskuns definition; 'daarin ingekerf' is a lateral and slightly clumsier move.
